software.memoryMeasurementRoot: Electron main process and descendants; Playwright launcher excluded

startupPhases.method: Milliseconds from the benchmark's launch call to each main-process mark (epoch clock shared by both processes); coreConnected is when the renderer first shows "Core connected". A phase without samples was not marked by this build.

processMemoryBreakdown.method: Each sample uses a fresh packaged application profile. Working Set and private bytes are captured after a 5-second settle. Private Working Set uses three process-tree samples per phase with 300ms requested spacing; its peak is reported separately because the plan does not currently define which Windows memory counter is the acceptance metric.
